discussion.body: SET-1.0 Field core — impl status: built, not done (gates). Square world, origin center, Y-up, bounds ±1e8, default zoom 3/5 inward on a log scale, tools select/hand/frame/pen/shape/text/arrow, sequence rail, save on major action + 60s, export PDF/PNG/JSON. Exit (draw at default zoom, reload, export; geometry survives) is true in the running app. Not marking the set done: gate BUG-001 is impl-fixed, not design-verified. BUG-002 is closed. How to verify: draw at default zoom, reload, export PDF/JSON, check geometry.
